research_venue.Name: Princes Street Gardens
research_venue.Native_Map_Query: Princes Street Gardens, Edinburgh, United Kingdom
research_venue.Description: Princes Street Gardens is Edinburgh's central historic park directly below the Castle, with different eastern and western sections and several public restrooms. CruisingGays records the gardens generally; Gays-Cruising indexes 'Toilets Prince's Street Garden', and two separate Squirt records identify Ross Bandstand and West public toilets. These may be facilities within the same gardens but should not be collapsed into a single exact pin. The City Council says the gardens open at 07:00 and close at 18:00 from 26 October to 31 December, with west gates starting to close at 17:00 and east at 17:15. Squirt's list showed a recent relative reply for Ross Bandstand as of 6 November 2026, but its detail page was inaccessible and the reply is not proof of an encounter.
research_venue.Opening_Notes: Gardens open 07:00–18:00 during current Oct26–Dec31 season; entry closure begins west 17:00, east 17:15. Council lists winter toilet Ross Bandstand 10:00–19:00 and West 10:00–20:00; this divergence from park gate hours needs confirmation of after-gate routes, not assumption of entry. Public restrooms under operator supervision and consent/privacy constraints.

research_venue.Name: London Road Gardens
research_venue.Native_Map_Query: London Road Gardens, Edinburgh, United Kingdom
research_venue.Description: London Road Gardens is the wooded city park on the eastern side of Calton Hill, reached from London Road. The original directory claims paths behind a 'Cottage' are visited late at night but supplies zero dated comments. A council park page and Woodland Trust both identify London Road Gardens; crucially the Woodland Trust explains it was historically named Royal Terrace Gardens, and the newly opened Cottage restaurant occupies the old gardener's cottage in Royal Terrace Gardens. This makes the queued Royal Terrace Gardens #540 a high-confidence possible duplicate or overlapping garden, not a separate cruising location by default. No current sex-meeting activity verified.
research_venue.Opening_Notes: Public wooded city park, with active walking and restaurant path. Exact garden gate/night access unknown; restaurant operating times do not apply to all park paths. Do not infer after-midnight entry from undated adult directory suggestion. Public recreation and consenting behaviour rules.
